summary: CEA Industries Inc. filed an 8-K reporting purely administrative corporate actions. On September 4, 2026, it filed Certificates of Withdrawal with the Nevada Secretary of State to eliminate the certificate of designations for its Series A Preferred Stock and Series B Convertible Preferred Stock, neither of which had any shares outstanding. It also filed Restated Articles of Incorporation that restate the charter without effecting any amendment. The filing includes an updated Description of Securities that does not change any security terms. No special situation—no transaction, event, or strategic action—is involved; this is routine housekeeping.
